## Rule

**count → recolor → render row** (verified 261/261 arc-gen, 2026-07-07):
input 3×3 has a single non-zero color `c` appearing `k` times (k∈[1,9]); output is a **1×k** row
filled with `c`. Data-dependent in BOTH width `k` and color `c` (single nonzero color always).

**LIVE best = cost 78** (`600ce7fa…`, Vamshi) — NOT the stale 980 local graph in the AUTO block below.
Graph `task339_selected_direct_reduction_roi` (5 nodes): Einsum count → ReduceMax `k` → Reciprocal
`1/k` → Concat ROI `[0,0,1/k,1]` → **RoiAlign renders the k-wide bar directly to the graph output**.

## Algorithm sketch

```
counts[c] = sum(input==c)  over 3x3, mask channel 0        # [1,10,1,1], =k at active c
k         = max(counts)                                     # scalar
roi       = [x1=0, y1=0, x2=1/k, y2=1]                      # ROI width 1/k
output    = RoiAlign(counts, roi) -> [1,10,30,30]           # k-wide colored bar, argmax-decoded
```

## Cost analysis

**Live 78 = memory 64 + params 14** (profile=static=78, 266 real inputs). Forced components:
`foreground_counts[1,10,1,1]` F32 **40 B** (RoiAlign must carry all 10 channels for color identity;
F16 impossible — Einsum follows F32 input, a Cast leaves the F32 tensor still counted), `count`(4)+
`inverse_count`(4) for ROI width `1/k`, `rois[1,4]`(16); `mask`(10, zero bg channel 0) + ROI coords(4).
**Live graph IS the RoiAlign-family floor.** The winning trick: the only big tensor `[1,10,30,30]` is the
graph OUTPUT (free); any alternative materializing the k-wide bar as an intermediate pays ≥ live.

## Don't-do log

- **crop-to-3x9** (2026-05-19): SKIP — false positive. Scoring skips 'input'/'output'. Crop adds 'input_cropped'[1,10,3,9]=1080B overhead. Proven via task073 test (cost 1411→2423).
- **perfect-25 ≤1 zero-cost family** (2026-07-07): DEAD. Output width `k` and color `c` are both
  data-dependent → no no-payload direct-output op (Identity/Transpose/flip/rotate) is visible-correct.
  Do not re-open the zero-param family. Kill rule satisfied without gating.
- **Expand/Tile / ramp+Less / Resize / ConvTranspose to beat 78** (2026-07-07): DEAD. All materialize a
  k-wide bar as an intermediate (Expand→[1,10,1,9]=360B; ramp iota=30 params) ≥ live 78. Only RoiAlign
  renders a data-dependent-width partial bar directly to the (free) graph output. See hard_records/.
